initial.response: (1) Line 17 literally admits every pair outside a larger group. Require a common physical witness at two distinct live holders for each uncovered pair; a holder is no witness to itself merely by identity. At positive ages use actual parent rosters. In a physically connected holding with separated live groups this difference can invent a new birth and a false shortage. (2) Strengthen the zero-candidate case: independently compare the spent-name indicator of every candidate allowed zero by the arity/demand rules (or every paid candidate) with the old physical GF(2) row span, recording missing/extra support against the full old loose-name set and old/new rank on positives. Include a known physically connected, split-live negative where one child exhausts its own component but other loose names survive, verified by the named row check; the ordinary-end paper already supplies the one-global-bit example. A six-founder positive alone cannot distinguish a whole test from a per-component test. Freeze a funnel (all, initially funded, one live group, sole whole-paying candidates, verified zero) with exact counts/masses, so zero funded connected candidates can be distinguished from an unsuccessful closing candidate. With multiple funded live groups, each has a child, none spans old groups, and children from different groups never share a parent; if every funded source already splits, these facts and the full row-span test give an all-age deduction separately from measured fates. Preselect a first funded split control when the connected stratum is empty, and a stall plus archived controls when there are no funded sources. (3) Reconcile lines 21/25/29: a hit allows an existential answer; universal population weights and ranked minima require all decorated orbits to be reconciled. Prefer full census after a hit as planned; any incomplete result must retain censored counts and masses by law, identify a reported specimen as provisional, and withhold population-wide frequencies/rank. The decorated orbit and spanning-tree denominator formulas are sound. This review used historical results, the prospective text and the general law only; no seven-founder output was produced or read.

final.response:
The revision resolves the principal scientific objection. A child can consume every loose distinction in its live component while another component still has openings. The design tests each candidate for a zero grant against the full physical parity rows. The archived four-founder comparison holds the child’s three inputs fixed and changes the answer by adding openings elsewhere.

The pair rule now requires a common physical witness. The design accounts for empty candidate populations, retains refused starts under both weightings, and reserves population frequencies and rankings for a reconciled census. This receipt covers the design only. Seven-founder outcomes were unexamined.
